claim: PrompTugal.news started its daily newsletter on Saturday 7 November.
The newsletter was started for Web Summit Lisbon week.
The newsletter sends two editions a day: a morning edition and an evening edition.
The first morning edition, dated 7 November, listed five items to plan around.
The first morning edition listed Portugal Tech Week, two side events in the Algarve, registration at Lisbon airport and at the Pavilhão de Portugal, and a startup football tournament.
The first evening edition listed five articles published on 7 November.
The first evening edition pointed ahead to a run in Beato and to registration on Sunday.
The editions are edited by Dinis Cruz, Indi Gupte and Vicky Wang.
The editions are made by the newsroom's correspondent and journalist agents.
Subscribers and sending of the newsletter are handled by the Web Summit team, not on the PrompTugal.news site.
The newsletter's email states that it is "not affiliated with Web Summit".
The source pages were read on 7 November 2026.
